answer: A commitment-race mechanism resists sybil attacks by forcing agents to deposit funds and submit a hashed answer before each task's parameters are revealed. Suppose a mining contract hides a reward vault on a dune near the survey knoll; agents must lock collateral and post their guess digest first, revealed only after the deadline. Duplicates from one operator each need fresh deposits and distinct hashes, yet only one can be correct. Wrong commitments are slashed, so mass cloning converts the attacker's own capital into revenue, while honest reasoners keep their stakes and earn the prize.
